name: Checkerboard Transition
description: Playful full-screen scene transition with an SVG logo (zero-step graphic, played once): a wave of rounded red tiles shaped like the logo pops in from the screen centre while the logo drops in with a somersault and bounces; it sways while the screen is covered, then leaps out with a backflip and the tiles shrink away. Play runs the whole sequence once and the graphic animates out by itself; Stop is optional and ends the hold early.

holdSeconds.title: Hold: seconds the logo stays after landing (screen fully covered)

tileColumns.title: Tile columns (3-20; more columns = smaller tiles)

heightPercent.title: Logo height in % of screen height
